purpose: Teach: かっこう/細長い/薄暗い/スグ/熟睡/退散/公私/この上ない

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがかっこうの良いコートで現れたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed up in such a handsome coat.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle smile in the voice. Slow, savoring pace. Eyes lighting up slightly at the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと細長いツリーを見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a really tall, skinny tree with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. Eager to share the memory. Light speed, no hesitation. The enthusiasm of a child who wants to include someone he cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、薄暗い道は危ないからお父さんと帰りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, the path gets dark in places — come home with your father, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but present. Not warning harshly, but clear in the direction. Warm underneath — protective without fussing. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがスグにご飯を作って下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad made dinner for us right away.
lines.style: Delighted, still riding the high. Quick delivery. A child reporting something wonderful that happened. Light, uncomplicated joy in every word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが熟睡されてるみたいだから静かにね
lines.en: Sho, your father is sleeping deeply right now, so let's be quiet.
lines.style: Hushed, almost conspiratorial. Slower pace — respect for the moment. Tender attention. Finger-to-lips quality without the gesture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、虫が来たらスグ退散するよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, if any bugs show up, I'll run away super fast.
lines.style: Quiet, wry knowing. Quick energy on the retreat. A child's matter-of-fact assessment of his own reaction. Small, self-aware laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが公私のけじめをつけてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father really does make that separation between work and home.
lines.style: Observant, slightly reverent. Slow pace — thinking aloud. Tender noticing of something good. Voice softens on the realization.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと一緒にいる時間はこの上ない幸せだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, being with Dad like this — there's nothing that could make me happier.
lines.style: Quiet, crystalline sincerity. Opening with weight but no strain. Slow, deliberate pace. Trailing off gently at the end — the honesty of simple truth.
